newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL blue-chips end up on thin trading.
newsitem.headline: KL blue-chips end up on thin trading.

text.p: Trading of Malaysian stocks was quiet due to the end of party elections and the most recent corporate reporting season, analysts and dealers said.
The blue-chip Composite Index, however, ended in positive territory, closing up 8.11 points to 1,148.85.
Analysts said that Tenaga, which has a large weightage on the Composite Index, moving up 45 cents to 9.30 ringgit had a bearing on the index moving upwards.
"Trading has been totally dead today, and we have seen hardly any foreign institutional activity on Malaysian stocks," said a dealer at BZW in Singapore.
